chapter.verse: Jericho khua ah Jesu lutin khuasung tawn hi.
Tu-in, en un, Zacchaeus minnei mi khat om a, amah pen siahdong ulian leh mihau khat ahi hi.
Jesu kua hiam cih thei nuamin hanciam a, ahi zongin amah a tuntom khat ahih manin mihonpi' huhau-in mu zolo hi
Tua hangin amah na ma tai a, Jesu a muh theih nadingin theithek kung khat tungah kah hi. A hang pen Jesu in tua mun tawn ding ahih man hi.
Tua mun ah Jesu a tun ciangin dakto a, "Zacchaeus aw, manlangin hong kumsuk in. A hang pen tuni na inn ah kong taam kul ding hi," ci hi.
Zacchaeus zong manlangtak kumsuk a, nuamna tawh Jesu zindo hi.
Hih thupiang a muh uh ciangin mi khempeuh phun uh a, "Mawhnei mi khat' kiangah amah lutin zintung tazen hi," ci uh hi.
Zacchaeus dingto-in Topa hopih a, "Topa aw, en in. Ka neihsa a lang mizawngte ka pia ding hi. Mi khatpeuh khemin na khatpeuh ka laksak a om leh a zah li ka dinkik ding hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in ama' kiangah, "Amah zong Abraham' ta khat mah ahih manin tuni-in hih inn ah hotkhiatna tung ta hi.
A hang pen a mangthangte a zong ding leh a honkhia dingin Mihing' Tapa hong pai ahi hi," ci hi.

Hih thute mite in a ngaih laitakun Jesu in thugenteh khat a kizomin gensuak hi. A hang pen Amah Jerusalem tung kuan ta a, mite in lah Pasian' kumpigam thakhatin hong kilang pah ding sa uh ahih man hi.
Tua hangin Jesu in hih bangin ci hi: "Seisang ulian khat, ama' uk ding kumpigam khat a va sang dingin leh a ciahkik dingin gamdang gamlapi khat ah va zin hi.
A silate mi sawm samin mina sawm ap a, 'Kong tunkik mateng summet na bawl un,' ci-in vaikhak hi.
Ahih hangin a gammite in ulianpa hua uh ahih manin, 'Hih mipa ko hong uk dingin ka deih kei uh hi,' a ci dingin ama' nungah palai beelpawl khat sawl uh hi.
Ulianpa, kumpigam a san khit, hong ciah ciangin a sum apna silate a sumbawlna uh pan bangzah ngah uh cih a theih nadingin ama' kiangah a pai nadingun samsak hi.
A masapa hong pai-in, 'Topa aw, nong mina ap pen mina sawm pha ta hi,' ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in, 'Pha hi, a gina silapa aw! A thuneu mahmah khat ah citak na hih manin khuapi sawm tungah uktheihna thu na nei ding hi,' ci hi.
Tua ciangin a nihnapa hong pai-in 'Topa aw, nong mina ap pen mina nga pha ta hi,' ci hi.
Kumpipa in, 'Tua ahihleh khuapi nga na uk ding hi,' ci hi.
A dang khat hong pai-in, 'Topa aw, en dih in. Nong mina ap pen mainul khat sungah tunin ka kemcip hi.
A hang pen migenhak khat na hih manin kong kihta hi. Koihkhol lo pi-in na la a, vawh lo pi-in na lo hi,' ci hi.
Kumpipa in, 'Nang sila ginalopa! Nangma' kampau mah tawh kong mawhmat ding hi. Koihkhol lo piin a la, vawh lo pi-in a lo, migenhak khat ci-in hong thei na hi hiam?
Tua ding in, kong ciah teh ka sumte a met tawh kong lakkik theih nadingin bang hangin sumkholna ah na koih lo na hi hiam?' ci hi.
Tua ciangin a gei-a dingte' kiangah, 'Hih mipa a mina laksak unla mina sawm a neipa tungah pia un,' ci hi.
Amaute in, 'Topa aw, amah'n mina sawm nei khin!' ci uh hi.
Ulianpa in, 'Ke'n kong cihin ah a neite khempeuh kipiabeh ding a, a neilote ahihleh a neihsun nangawn kilaksak ding hi.
Keima' uk ding a ut lo hih ka galte ahihleh hih takah hong paipih unla ka mai-ah that un,' ci hi."
Hih thute a gen khit ciangin Jerusalem paisuak dingin Jesu dingkhia masa hi.
Olive a kici mualdung khat-a om Bethphageb leh Bethany khuate a naih ciangin Jesu in nungzuite nih sawl a,
"Note mai-a om khua ah va pai un. Khuasung na lut ciangun kuama' tuan ngei nailo lano khat khau kikhih na mu ding uh hi. Tua lano a khau sutkhia-in hih takah hong paipih un.
Bang hangin lano khau sutkhia na hi uh hiam?' ci-in hong dong khatpeuh a om leh, 'Topa' ading hih kisam hi,' ci un," ci-in vaikhak hi.
Tua bang mahin a kisawlte paikhia uh a, Jesu' gen bang lianin lano mu uh hi.
Lano khau a sutkhiat laitakun a neite in amaute' kiangah, "Bang hangin lano khau sutkhia na hi uh hiam?" ci uh hi.
Nungzuite in, "Topa' ading hih kisam hi," ci-in dawng uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Jesu' kiangah lano paipih uh a, lano tungah a puante uh phahin Jesu tuangsak uh hi.
Lano tung tuangin Jesu a pai ciangin mite in lampi tungah a puante uh phah uh hi.
Olive Mual pan paisukna lampi naihin a tun ciangin ama' nungzui mihonpi bup in a muhkhak uh nalamdangte hangin nuamin awging lianpi tawh Pasian phat uh a,
"Topa' min tawh hong pai Kumpipa thuphangah ahi hi! Vantung ah nopna lemna om henla sangbelna ah minphatna om ta hen!" ci uh hi.
Mihonpi laka om Pharisee mi kimkhat in Jesu' kiangah, "Sya aw, na nungzuite taai in," ci uh hi.
Jesu in, "Ke'n kong cihin ah amaute a daih uhleh suangtumte awngkhia ding uh hi," ci hi.
Jerusalem naihin khuapi a muh ciangin Jesu in hih bangin tamlawh hi:
"Nopna lemna a piangsak thute, nangmahmah in zong tuni-in a thei na hih ding ka utdan! Ahi zongin tu-in tuate na muhna pan kiseel hi.
A hang pen na galte in na kimkot ah kan bawlin nang hong uumcihin mun citeng pan hong gakcip hun,
nang leh na sunga na tate a kinilkhiatsiang hun hong tung ding a, Pasian' hong hawh hun thei lo na hih manin amaute in na sungah suangtum kiciang khat zong omsak lo ding uh hi."
Tua ciangin biakinnpi sungah Jesu lutin vanzuak mite hawlkhiat ding kipan a,
"Lai kigelh sungah, 'Ka innpi pen thungetna inn hiding hi,' kici napi note in guta buluhte' bukna kua na suaksak uh hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in nisimin biakinnpi ah thu hilhcian hi. Siampi liante, laisiamte leh makai uliante in amah suamlup sawm uh a,
ahi zongin mi khempeuh in thu lungluttak ngai den uh ahih manin amah suk theih nading hun ngah theilo uh hi.Jesu' Uktheihna Thu Kidongtel
